items.title: Turing Institute adds three new trustees to its Board
items.summary_en: The Alan Turing Institute has appointed Tracey Bowen-Lowe, Catherine Graham and Rakshit Kapoor as non-executive directors and trustees. They join as Carina Namih finishes her term. Interim chair Dr Vanessa Lawrence said the appointments add expertise for the institute's AI and data science work.

items.title: Turing defence researchers' AI model flags unusual satellite behaviour
items.summary_en: Researchers at the Turing's Defence AI Research Centre built a model that learns from telescope brightness readings to flag abnormal satellite activity. It is meant to support space traffic management and collision avoidance. Coverage says it is published in the journal Expert Systems and is part of the UK Space Agency-funded AI4 Space Safety and Sustainability consortium.
items.notes: Likely outside the window. A search summary claimed a Turing item dated 9 Oct ('New AI model will boost UK's ability to safeguard vital satellites') but it could not be found or confirmed. An 88% detection figure appeared in only one outlet and is not included. Needs human check against turing.ac.uk.

items.title: Turing evidence pack on AI for grid operations
items.summary_en: A Turing evidence pack says AI-based forecasting delivers over 50 million pounds per year in balancing cost savings. It sets out steps for energy regulators and government bodies to speed up adoption. These details come from a search summary, not the page itself.

items.title: CETaS report on acting under uncertainty about frontier AI risk, plus a 2M pound grant
items.summary_en: According to a search summary, a report dated 23 September 2026 argues that uncertainty about future existential threats should not delay action. The same summary says the Turing's CETaS centre received a 2 million pound grant from Coefficient Giving to study security risks of transformative AI.
items.notes: Outside the window; context only. Link is the CETaS homepage, not the specific report. Title and authors unverified.
